zoe: design check 6 checklist for API creds empty state + revoke UX. mock: https://img.redwood.mock/creds-empty-v4.png. main goals: avoid accidental deletes, clear create/import paths, strong a11y. quick takes? rahul: general: don't surface revoke on empty screen. primary CTA should be Create, secondary Import. Revoke belongs only on per-key rows or the key detail panel. marie: agree. also propose moving warnings out of the empty state header into contextual banners on list rows so theyre scoped. empty state should be friendly and action-oriented. ben: modal pattern for revoke: require typing the key name to confirm for high-risk credentials (checkbox for "I understand" for low-risk). modal copy: "This will immediately disable the credential and may affect running services." CTA: [Cancel] [Revoke credential 1 danger]. undo toast after action. zoe: followups: when to require typed confirmation vs simple confirm? suggest typed only for keys with last-used < 24h or keys attached to >1 service. marie: accessibility notes: when modal opens set focus to the modal heading, trap focus, and ensure Escape closes modal and returns focus to the button that opened it. use aria-describedby to point to full explanation list. example snippet:

Revoke credential

Revoking will invalidate all tokens immediately. Impact: ...
 rahul: good. also keyboard-only users need visible focus rings on table rows and on the destructive button (2px focus ring). color contrast: our current orange text on white for warnings is below AA. use #7A4100 on yellow or darker text. run axe before merge. ben: copy tweak: instead of "Rotate" maybe "Rotate (safe)" is awkward. Let's show a tooltip: "Rotate: create a replacement key and keep both active for a TTL". in the rotate modal show a toggle "Overlap period: 10m/1h/24h" and show an estimated outage risk score. ux-bot: automated scan: empty-state illustration spacing fails at 360px width; CTA touches baseline at 16px margin. Suggest 24px vertical padding at mobile. Also suggest primary CTA full-width on mobile. marie: on the empty-state copy: current "No credentials yet" is fine but add supportive line: "Create a credential to authenticate Redwood API calls or import an existing key." then two CTAs. keep microcopy short. zoe: telemetry question: should we surface "last used" on empty? no. On list view show column 'last used' with relative time. Also permission scoping: in create modal show preselected least-privilege scopes and a link "learn about scopes". rahul: security requirement: only owners can revoke keys by default. add role gating in UI with tooltip: "You need Owner role to revoke." Disable revoke control if missing permission and show a help link. ben: undo UX: toast with 10s timer and explicit "Undo". If undone, restore key and show success toast. Also write audit log event with who revoked, time, and whether undone. infra-bot: infra note: make sure revoke triggers immediate cache invalidation on edge tokens, and emit websocket event to notify connected clients if they are using that key. marie: mobile pattern: modal becomes full-screen bottom sheet; typed confirmation flows should scroll to keyboard safely. CTA layout: primary fixed to bottom, secondary above it. zoe: consensus actions: - marie: update mocks with spacing + mobile sheet + aria attributes. - rahul: update copy for modals, add role gating tooltip and contrast fixes. - ben: propose rotate checklist and TTL options, update spec for typed confirmations logic. - infra-bot: ensure revoke websocket + cache invalidation spec. marie: I'll drop updated frames and the accessibility checklist in this thread by EOD. zoe: thanks team 1 :+1:
